# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed performance ports** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ports several hot-path color and pixel conversions to managed C#, built on Skia m151. It also adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone 151, with several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs merged in afterwards. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly support** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so apps can target .NET 11 on WebAssembly ahead of general availability. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## Bug Fixes

- **Managed color and pixel conversions ported for correctness and speed** — SKColor→SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer/float math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and a CPU raster regression from a missing legacy shader-context flag was fixed. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) resource leak fixed** — A native resource leak when decoding a subset region of encoded image data is now fixed. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ports HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag/SKFourByteTag parsing to allocation-free managed implementations for lower per-call overhead.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

The release candidate finished porting SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions to managed code, fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak, and merged further chrome/m151 upstream fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 added the .NET 11 WASM Emscripten libraries, fixed a CPU raster regression from a dropped legacy shader-context flag, and ported HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing to allocation-free managed code.
